import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns

# Read the data
df = pd.read_csv('data.csv')

# Create a figure with subplots
fig, axes = plt.subplots(2, 3, figsize=(16, 10))
fig.suptitle('Coffee Shop Sales Analysis', fontsize=16, fontweight='bold')

# 1. Sales by Product
product_sales = df.groupby('product')['total'].sum().sort_values(ascending=False)
axes[0, 0].bar(product_sales.index, product_sales.values, color='#8B4513')
axes[0, 0].set_title('Total Sales by Product', fontweight='bold')
axes[0, 0].set_xlabel('Product')
axes[0, 0].set_ylabel('Total Sales ($)')
axes[0, 0].tick_params(axis='x', rotation=45)

# 2. Sales by Customer Age Group
age_sales = df.groupby('customer_age_group')['total'].sum().sort_values(ascending=False)
colors = ['#D2691E', '#CD853F', '#DEB887', '#F5DEB3']
axes[0, 1].bar(age_sales.index, age_sales.values, color=colors[:len(age_sales)])
axes[0, 1].set_title('Sales by Age Group', fontweight='bold')
axes[0, 1].set_xlabel('Age Group')
axes[0, 1].set_ylabel('Total Sales ($)')

# 3. Payment Method Distribution
payment_counts = df['payment_method'].value_counts()
axes[0, 2].pie(payment_counts.values, labels=payment_counts.index, autopct='%1.1f%%', 
               colors=['#8B4513', '#CD853F'], startangle=90)
axes[0, 2].set_title('Payment Method Distribution', fontweight='bold')

# 4. Sales by Size
size_sales = df.groupby('size')['total'].sum().sort_values(ascending=False)
axes[1, 0].barh(size_sales.index, size_sales.values, color='#A0522D')
axes[1, 0].set_title('Sales by Size', fontweight='bold')
axes[1, 0].set_xlabel('Total Sales ($)')
axes[1, 0].set_ylabel('Size')

# 5. Takeaway vs Dine-in
takeaway_sales = df.groupby('is_takeaway')['total'].sum()
takeaway_labels = ['Dine-in' if x == 0 else 'Takeaway' for x in takeaway_sales.index]
axes[1, 1].bar(takeaway_labels, takeaway_sales.values, color=['#8B4513', '#D2691E'])
axes[1, 1].set_title('Takeaway vs Dine-in Sales', fontweight='bold')
axes[1, 1].set_xlabel('Service Type')
axes[1, 1].set_ylabel('Total Sales ($)')

# 6. Sales over Time
df['datetime'] = pd.to_datetime(df['date'] + ' ' + df['time'])
time_sales = df.groupby('time')['total'].sum().sort_index()
axes[1, 2].plot(range(len(time_sales)), time_sales.values, marker='o', 
                linewidth=2, markersize=8, color='#8B4513')
axes[1, 2].set_title('Sales by Time of Day', fontweight='bold')
axes[1, 2].set_xlabel('Time')
axes[1, 2].set_ylabel('Total Sales ($)')
axes[1, 2].set_xticks(range(len(time_sales)))
axes[1, 2].set_xticklabels(time_sales.index, rotation=45)
axes[1, 2].grid(True, alpha=0.3)

plt.tight_layout()
plt.savefig('output.png', dpi=300, bbox_inches='tight')
plt.close()
